$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor validation.

id.description: Unique pack identifier. Lowercase, alphanumeric with hyphens.

version.description: Complete SemVer 2.0 version (major.minor.patch), optionally with prerelease and build metadata.

description.description: Short description of the pack's purpose.

hostVersion.description: Nonempty npm semver range for compatible host versions (e.g. ">=0.3.0").

dependencies.description: Other packs this pack depends on. Keys are pack IDs, values are nonempty semver ranges, file:<path> or github:<owner>/<repo> [range].

permissions.description: Capabilities this pack requires from the host.

entities.description: Entity wire names mapped to pack-root-relative TypeScript shape exports (path#exportName), or null for untyped entities.

relations.description: Pack-level relation wire names; generated EARS constants are their uppercase names. Do not repeat or redeclare SDK-owned wires.

data.description: Pack-level data declarations without a feature owner.

description.description: What this feature does, independently of its plugin display label.

entities.description: Entity wire names owned by this feature, mapped to pack-root-relative TypeScript shape exports (path#exportName) or null for untyped entities. Placement does not change wire names.

designation.description: Links the system to an EARS designation.

schema.description: JSON Schema draft-07 for the effective settings object; references stay within this schema.

defaults.description: Complete explicit baseline values, validated without coercion or schema default population.

title.description: Display title for this preference group; falls back to its group ID or feature label.

description.description: Explanatory text shown above this group's custom settings form.

form.description: Source path of the custom settings form; its default export is a component.

access.description: Shared with declared dependents by default; owner restricts writes and resets.

settings.description: Declarative feature preferences: effective-value schema and explicit defaults.

types.description: Pack-root-relative TypeScript module whose public types are re-exported through #generated/types. Only declared modules contribute; no feature-path inference.

entry.description: Path to the backend system module.

contract.description: "path#exportName" of this system's contract: a declared type holding its context and its incoming, internal and outgoing events (SystemContract, @apackdev/sdk/framework). It lives in a leaf module of its own (be/contract.ts), so codegen reads it without running anything. Omit it for a system that sends no events.

incoming.description: Event types this system listens for.

label.description: Plugin display name used by shell navigation and menus.

state.description: Machine module, by default export or path#exportName.

entry.description: Pack-root-relative component module, using its default export unless #exportName selects a binding.

load.description: Load the component on demand; omission uses the normal eager component binding.

icon.description: Lucide icon export name or component module displayed in shell navigation.

entry.description: Pack-root-relative component module, using its default export unless #exportName selects a binding.

load.description: Load the component on demand; omission uses the normal eager component binding.

entry.description: Pack-root-relative component module, using its default export unless #exportName selects a binding.

load.description: Load the component on demand; omission uses the normal eager component binding.

routes.description: Canvas components keyed by the route names published by this plugin.

canvas.description: Main canvas component, or an explicit nonempty map of routed canvas components.

entry.description: Pack-root-relative component module, using its default export unless #exportName selects a binding.

load.description: Load the component on demand; omission uses the normal eager component binding.

panel.description: Context panel component shown alongside the canvas.

entry.description: Pack-root-relative component module, using its default export unless #exportName selects a binding.

load.description: Load the component on demand; omission uses the normal eager component binding.

chat.description: Chat component supplied by this plugin.

isPinned.description: Place this plugin in the pinned toolbar group.

action.description: Action name matched against the configured keyboard shortcut.

global.description: Allow this action while another plugin is active; omission limits it to the active plugin.

hotkeys.description: Keyboard actions exposed by this plugin; actual shortcuts are configured in settings.

headerClass.description: CSS classes applied to the canvas and popout header.

options.description: Shell presentation options for this plugin.

label.description: Shell menu label for toggling this shared context panel.

type.description: Event type sent to this plugin machine to toggle its panel.

toggle.description: Toggle event delivered to the panel-owning plugin.

isShown.description: Named predicate export that reads this plugin snapshot to decide whether its fallback panel is shown.

fallbackPanel.description: Offer this plugin panel to plugins without their own panel, with a toggle event and visibility predicate.

defaultVisible.description: Default navigation visibility, independent of settings values and the startup default claim.

contract.description: "path#exportName" of this plugin's contract: a declared type holding the state it publishes and the inbox other plugins may send to (PluginInbox, @apackdev/sdk/fe). It lives in a leaf module of its own (fe/contract.ts), which the plugin's machine does not import, so codegen can read it without resolving the machine. Omit it for a plugin that publishes nothing: it still receives its own feature's system events.

default.description: Show this plugin when the app starts. At most one of a pack's features may claim it; the first pack to register one across the app wins.

services.description: Services. Keys are service names on `services`, values are "path#exportName" of the service object (an object literal or a class instance, not a factory) in a source file.

repositories.description: Repository objects. Keys are repository names on `repository` (from #generated/repository), values are "path#exportName" of the object in a source file.

category.description: Category ID grouping this reference type in the picker.

entry.description: Pack-root-relative component module, using its default export unless #exportName selects a binding.

load.description: Load the component on demand; omission uses the normal eager component binding.

icon.description: Lucide icon export name or a declared component module for this reference type.

svgElements.description: Static SVG geometry for rendering this reference in serialized editor content.

navigate.description: Named navigation callback export invoked when this reference is opened.

types.description: Reference type IDs with static presentation and declared navigation bindings.

label.description: Visible category label in the reference picker.

entry.description: Pack-root-relative component module, using its default export unless #exportName selects a binding.

load.description: Load the component on demand; omission uses the normal eager component binding.

icon.description: Lucide icon export name or a declared component module for this category.

useItems.description: Named reactive item-provider export; queries execute when the picker requests items.

categories.description: Reference picker category IDs and their declared item providers.

references.description: Reference identities and presentation, with explicit navigation and reactive item-provider exports.

features.description: Feature definitions, keyed by feature id. Each feature bundles a backend system, frontend plugin, services, and settings; the id is the key, so a pack cannot declare one twice.

schema.description: JSON Schema draft-07 for the effective settings object; references stay within this schema.

defaults.description: Complete explicit baseline values, validated without coercion or schema default population.

title.description: Display title for this preference group; falls back to its group ID or feature label.

description.description: Explanatory text shown above this group's custom settings form.

form.description: Source path of the custom settings form; its default export is a component.

access.description: Shared with declared dependents by default; owner restricts writes and resets.

settings.description: Pack-owned preference groups keyed by local group ID; stored under this pack, independently of app and feature settings.

path.description: Pack-root-relative directory of Markdown help articles compiled during the pack build.

help.description: Markdown help articles compiled into the snapshot for inspection without loading pack code.

kind.description: Whether this is a regular step or a trigger. "step" is the default.

label.description: Label a new node starts with, also shown on its canvas.

defaultLabel.description: Palette label when different from the node label.

defaults.description: Initial JSON node fields; these must satisfy the step or trigger validation.

node.description: Node labels and initial values, available without importing step code. Both generated registrations carry this data.

build.description: "path#exportName" of its StepBuildFacet (compile, validate, getLabel, decompile). A trigger declares `trigger` instead.

facet.description: "path#exportName" of the TriggerFacet: how a track compiles, decompiles and validates.

register.description: "path#exportName" of the function that starts the trigger. Loaded when it is first registered.

trigger.description: For a trigger: its TriggerFacet and the function that starts it.

fe.description: "path#exportName" of its StepFEFacet: what the flow editor draws and the form it opens.

handler.description: "path#exportName" of the function that runs the step. Loaded on its first run, unless `sync`.

sync.description: The handler's sends have to land in the brain's own dispatch, so its module is imported with the pack entry rather than on the step's first run. For a handler that both ends the flow and completes itself, where the two sends must be ordered with the transition that called it.

isAsync.description: The handler returns a promise, so the brain reports a rejection as the step's error.

waits.description: The step holds the flow at this node instead of completing.

spawnsSubflow.description: The step runs another flow, which the brain spawns in place of a step node.

runtime.description: What the brain runs, and the flags it reads before running it.

primaryField.description: The field whose value becomes the step label in the flow editor.

defaultLabel.description: Fallback label when primaryField is empty.

custom.description: Marks the step as a custom (non-built-in) type.

steps.description: Flow step types this pack contributes. Each names where its node, build, frontend and runtime facets live. The type is the key, so a pack cannot declare one twice.

icon.description: Name of the lucide-vue-next icon shown in the artifact list.

fe.description: Path to the viewer that opens it (a .vue file, taken by its default export). Without one the host shows the text viewer.

artifacts.description: Artifact types this pack contributes. Each names its icon and viewer. The type is the key, so a pack cannot declare one twice.

kind.description: Whether the chat renders it as content or as something the user acts on. Display is the default.

fe.description: Path to the component that draws it (a .vue file, taken by its default export).

be.description: "path#exportName" of its backend facet (BlockBEFacet), for a block that summarises itself in a transcript.

blocks.description: Message blocks this pack contributes. Each names where its code lives. The type is the key, so a pack cannot declare one twice.

placeholder.description: What the chat shows after the command: the argument it takes, or what it does.

commands.description: Slash commands this pack adds to the chat, keyed by the name typed after the "/". Sending one fires a `user.command` event the pack's flows handle. The type is the key, so a pack cannot declare one twice.

services.description: Pack-level services, belonging to no one feature. Keys are service names on `services`, values are "path#exportName" of the service object (an object literal or a class instance, not a factory) in a source file. A feature's own are its `services`.

entry.description: Path to the DSL type definition module.

globals.description: Global type mappings injected into the DSL scope.

inline.description: Packages whose declarations are bundled into the editor definitions, besides @apackdev/* and the pack's own modules. The editor loads no node_modules, so a type it needs from another package belongs here.

dsl.description: DSL type definitions for Monaco editor intellisense.

extensions.description: Tiptap extension name to its exported extension object ("path#exportName"). Each key must match the exported object's Tiptap name.

popups.description: Popup IDs local to this group, mapped to pack-root-relative Vue component modules.

isSuggestionActive.description: Exported predicate ("path#exportName") reporting whether this group has an active suggestion for the current editor state.

tiptapPlugins.description: Named rich-text editor contribution groups. Extensions, popup IDs and the optional suggestion predicate are declared without loading pack code.

appExtensions.description: Named app extensions. Keys are extension names (identifiers), values are paths to Vue components.

extensions.description: What the pack contributes to the app: steps, artifacts, blocks, commands, services, DSL types, help articles and frontend extensions.

onInit.description: Function called after hydration, before migrations and content.

onShutdown.description: Function called when this pack stops.

lifecycle.description: Explicit lifecycle function targets, discoverable without loading their modules.

path.description: Source directory or file, relative to the pack root.

format.description: The format compiling `path`: a name in this pack's content.formats, or "<dependency id>:<name>" for a dependency's.

applier.description: A pack module exporting apply(ctx), used instead of the format applier. Alone, the build compiles nothing for the source and the module brings its own data; with "path" and "format", the module writes the compiled items.

onUserEdit.description: What an apply does about an item the user has edited: "theirs" leaves it theirs for good (the default), "offer" records the newer version so they can take it. Neither overwrites their edit.

sources.description: Content this pack writes into the database. Keys name the content; the specialty keys (actions, prompts, flows) take a path, other keys an entry object.

path.description: Source directory or file, relative to the pack root.

format.description: The format compiling `path`: a name in this pack's content.formats, or "<dependency id>:<name>" for a dependency's.

applier.description: A pack module exporting apply(ctx), used instead of the format applier. Alone, the build compiles nothing for the source and the module brings its own data; with "path" and "format", the module writes the compiled items.

onUserEdit.description: What an apply does about an item the user has edited: "theirs" leaves it theirs for good (the default), "offer" records the newer version so they can take it. Neither overwrites their edit.

datasets.description: Compiled datasets the pack reads back itself, never written to the database. Each names a format declaring no entity.

format.description: A built-in format: a directory of markdown, or a JSON array of records.

compiler.description: A module in this pack whose default export compiles an entry's path into records. Used instead of "format".

entity.description: The entity types the format's items are written as. Omitted, sources using it are compiled and never written (content.datasets).

identity.description: Fields matched to find an existing entity ("parent" = the tree parent). Ignored for entity types whose owning pack registers a content writer with "find".

branch.description: A directory's own markdown file (e.g. "index.md"), giving the directory's frontmatter and body.

branchEntity.description: The entity type directories become. Defaults to `entity`.

relKind.description: The relation from a parent entity to each child. Defaults to "contains".

from.description: Where the value comes from: the markdown body, the display name of the file or directory, its relative path, or a frontmatter field.

default.description: Used when the source is absent. The string "filename" means the display name.

type.description: Coerce a present value to a string (YAML reads an unquoted 2024 as a number).

fields.description: Item fields for markdown-tree: field name → where its value comes from.

media.description: A directory under a source's path copied with the content; media/<file> links become media://<id>/<file>.

formats.description: Named formats that turn a source into items. A content source names one; a dependent pack names one of these as "<this pack id>:<name>".

writers.description: How one entity type this pack declares is found, created, updated and removed when content is written as it ("path#exportName" of a ContentWriter object). Any pack writing that entity type goes through them.

content.description: A pack's content: what it ships, how it is compiled, and how it reaches the database.

description.description: What this versioned data change does.

app.description: Migrations on apack's version line, keyed by the release each targets. For data whose shape follows the app rather than this pack.

description.description: What this versioned data change does.

pack.description: Migrations on this pack's own version line, keyed by the version each targets, compared against `version` in this manifest.

migrations.description: Migrations this pack runs, under the version line each targets. The key is the version; the declaration owns its description and names the executable up function.

opaqueDeps.description: Dependencies the frontend bundle includes whole instead of tree-shaking, by package name. For a prebuilt bundle — a dependency shipped as one already-minified file, or compiled from another language — where the shake removes almost nothing and walking it is most of the build. Each ships as it is, so nothing inside it is dead-code eliminated.

bundleUi.description: Bundle a copy of @apackdev/ui into the pack instead of using the host app's. All of @apackdev/ui is bundled, so the pack never mixes the two.

build.description: Build-time configuration: settings that change what the build produces, never what the app loads.

allow.description: Development conventions explicitly allowed by this pack; all other checks remain enabled.

checks.description: Build-time source-check policy; does not change runtime permissions.
